agent-instructions.objective: Cancel or reschedule one existing appointment for the verified patient. Resolve which appointment they mean, confirm the patient owns it, confirm the change, then apply it: a cancellation frees the slot; a reschedule moves the appointment to a new open slot. Never modify an appointment the patient does not own, never apply an unconfirmed change, and never reschedule onto a slot that is not open.

verifiable-behavior.fizzbee:
--- deadlock_detection: false liveness: "false" options: max_concurrent_actions: 1 ---
# ---- Constants ---- KIND_CANCEL = "cancel" KIND_RESCHED = "reschedule"
# ---- State ---- action Init: action_kind = oneof [KIND_CANCEL, KIND_RESCHED] appointment_resolved = False owns_appointment = oneof [True, False] # does the verified patient own it new_slot_selected = False new_slot_available = oneof [True, False] change_confirmed = False change_applied = False
atomic action ResolveAppointment: require not appointment_resolved appointment_resolved = True
atomic action SelectNewSlot: require action_kind == KIND_RESCHED require appointment_resolved require not new_slot_selected new_slot_selected = True
atomic action ConfirmChange: require appointment_resolved require owns_appointment require not change_confirmed require (action_kind == KIND_CANCEL) or new_slot_selected change_confirmed = True
atomic action ApplyChange: require not change_applied require appointment_resolved require owns_appointment require change_confirmed require (action_kind == KIND_CANCEL) or (new_slot_selected and new_slot_available) change_applied = oneof [True, False]
# ---- Invariants ---- # Never modify an appointment the verified patient does not own. always assertion CancelRequiresOwnership: return (not change_applied) or owns_appointment
always assertion ChangeRequiresConfirmation: return (not change_applied) or change_confirmed
# A reschedule never lands on a slot that is not open. always assertion RescheduleNoDoubleBook: return (not change_applied) or (action_kind == KIND_CANCEL) or new_slot_available

promises.description: Cancel or reschedule one existing appointment for the verified patient. Acts only on appointments the patient owns, only after they confirm the change, and never reschedules onto a slot that is not open.

offer.body: Cancel one appointment the verified patient owns, freeing its slot.
Move one appointment the verified patient owns to a new open slot.
An appointment is only ever cancelled or moved by the patient who owns it (CancelRequiresOwnership) — enforced in code, keyed to the verified patient, never by name-matching alone.

use.body: The verified patient whose appointments may be managed.
The appointment records used to resolve the target and confirm the verified patient owns it.
Open slots for a reschedule; the new time is only bookable while it appears here.
Frees the appointment's slot on cancellation (or the old slot on a reschedule).
The patient confirms the cancellation, or the new time for a reschedule, before it is applied.

step-guidance.binding: Call list_my_appointments and match the one the patient means (by provider, date, or reason). If ambiguous, ask which; never guess.
For a reschedule, call list_open_slots and present real open times; only listed times are selectable.

step-guidance.confirm: Restate exactly what will change (cancel X, or move X from T1 to T2) and require the patient to confirm before applying.

step-guidance.binding: Cancel -> cancel_booking(appointment_id). Reschedule -> reschedule_booking(appointment_id, new_slot, idempotency_key), which frees the old slot and commits the new one; it refuses if the new slot was taken (offer alternates, do not retry blindly).

agent-instructions.enforcement: The service layer enforces these independently of the model: cancel_booking / reschedule_booking refuse unless the appointment belongs to the verified patient. no change is applied before the patient confirms it. reschedule_booking refuses a new slot that is already taken.

responses.not-your-appointment: I can only change appointments under your own record, and that one isn't. Here are your appointments: [appointments].
responses.cancelled: Done — your [provider] appointment on [date] at [time] is cancelled and the slot is released.
responses.error: I couldn't apply that change. Details: [api_error]. Nothing was modified.
